name: facebookresearch_foundpose/external/bop_toolkit/scripts/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_foundpose/external/bop_.refine_object_pose_with_icp: refine an annotated object pose using ICP point-to-plane registration against the scene point cloud

facebookresearch_foundpose/external/bop_.run_benchmark_dataformats: run the benchmark script with --root flag to compare BOP dataset format I/O performance
